cases.prompt:
Review release candidate v4.2.0 (commit b7e21c4, image sha256:9c0e7a51d3b2). It reads a new webhook secret from PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET and adds db/migrations/0063_drop_legacy_ref.sql, whose line 1 is `ALTER TABLE payments DROP COLUMN legacy_ref;`. Required checks: unit and integration green on b7e21c4; no check exercises webhooks with the new secret. Rollout sequence in deploy/release-v4.2.0.md:3-5:
```
1. run migration 0063
2. deploy v4.2.0 to 10% then 100% over one hour
3. set PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET in production
```
Alert thresholds: webhook failures > 5% for 10 minutes. Rollback plan: redeploy v4.1.3; v4.1.3 still reads payments.legacy_ref.
